pricing.label: Fees
pricing.title: Regular practice, with flexible options.
notes: The reduced fee is available to unemployed people and students, with proof of status.
A reduced timetable runs in July and August and is published in June.
Buki Waza uses the Ken, a wooden sword, and the Jo, a staff approximately 1.27 m long.
Private classes are available; ask the dojo directly.

children.title: Growing with attention, discipline and joy.
paragraphs: With no competition, each child progresses at their own pace with the teacher's support.
Classes combine technique, games and exercises to develop the body, concentration, imagination, flexibility and reflexes.
